notes.title: Hainya World EA 2.0 Major Update!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=E-9_T3_MRls;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Hainya World EA 2.0 Major Update![/b][/h3]
After a whole year of development, it's finally here!
We've revamped many game mechanics, significantly enhanced the visuals, and added even more fun gameplay elements!

Welcome to the Hainya World!

An RPG of Adventure x Creation!
Dig, build, battle, and explore!
Fight monsters, level up, break terrain, and gather materials to build your own base!
The kingdom is under attack by monsters!
To save it, adventurers set off to explore an ancient continent in search of untold mysteries!


Venture into the Unknown

Ancient Land
A forgotten ancient continent, where adventurers journey to investigate abnormal monster activity. Here, they can freely alter the terrain and construct structures to explore this unknown region.

Narus Continent
The homeland of adventurers and the main continent where the hainyaworld people live. It is home to many prosperous towns and residents. You can visit this land and interact with its people!

More Equipment & Skills
A more diverse equipment system, with the ability to change weapon skills!

Over 15 combat-style weapon types:
﹝Sword & Shield, Greatsword, Axe﹞
﹝Spear, Dual Blades, Daggers, Katana, Gauntlets﹞
﹝Shortbow, Short Staff, Longbow, Long Staff, Holy Book, Dual Crossbows﹞
﹝Handgun, Shotgun, Sniper Rifle, Assault Rifle﹞
Over 100 unique weapons
Over 100 types of equipment
200 unique skills and techniques

An improved, easy-to-learn combat system—switch between different weapon styles at any time!



Battle Powerful Enemies and Claim Your Loot!
Haya World is filled with formidable foes!
Level up and upgrade your gear to take them on.
They carry rich rewards just waiting to be claimed!

More Fun-Filled Systems

Fashion-A new fashion system to make your character shine even more!

Pets-Collect over 10 types of companions!

Companions-You're never alone—team up with over 30 unique companions on your journey!

Vehicles-Ride in style—explore the vast world with 20 different vehicle styles!

Fishing-Become a master angler—catch over 50 types of fish!

Farming-Live off the land—grow crops and farm in your own base!


Controller Support
You can enjoy Haya World with an Xbox controller—no additional setup required!
The game is also fully playable on Steam Deck.

Online Co-op
Team up with friends through Steam's online features~
Adventure together, create together!
Build your own unique Haya World together!

notes.title: 《Hainya World》public early access release date!
notes.notes:
Hainya World is a sandbox action-adventure game in which the player can use different exploration methods to explore the vast world, not only by oneself, but also with three other friends at the same time. 
The player is an adventurer who needs to explore the world and utilize its resources to equip himself and survive in a world full of monsters and unknown things.

In the game, players can customize their characters, collect ores and various resources, build strongholds, and enjoy a variety of game content. 
The fast combos and skill system allow you to experience the different fighting styles of each Job to defeat the dangerous monsters. 
In addition, you'll be able to cook food, build and enchant weapons, craft tools, and explore the wider world. 
Players also have the chance to discover special copies of the world on the way to explore, these special copies of the many powerful monsters, after defeating these monsters, if you get a special item, you can use these special items, to unlock the appearance of fashion to create their own unique character.

At this stage of the early access version of the first three jobs, they are  melee job of the Force Shielder, can release a variety of magical attacks of  the Elementalist, and has a special attack mechanism of the Ranger, in the future version of the update will also be introduced to the other professions, please players look forward to it.

[h3]Early Access Trailer[/h3]
[previewyoutube=I5HvR2V70dI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]《Hainya world》 will be available for early access on September 1st on Steam.[/h3]
